objective_ko: D4 스킬 트리의 신규·변경 스킬과 main에서 정체성이 바뀐 스킬의 새 효과음 제작 계획. 생성 전 초안이며 음원은 아직 없다.
objective_en: Plan for new sound effects of skills added or changed by the D4 skill tree and by the main-branch identity rework. Pre-generation draft; no audio exists yet.
generation_note: A cue with several runtime variants needs one distinct generation per variant (same prompt, separate calls): skill.A15.hit 2, skill.A18.hit 3. Generated 2026-10-18 in ElevenLabs flow tcHr1hKn6p0at4pzyUOg: one take per new modifier cue (62); three cues were re-prompted once (A18-1, M08-1, M11-2). The 11 replace-existing rows (14 clips) were generated 2026-10-18 in flow 81oyAOAv3bzfGC0fFupM, one take per runtime variation, and replaced the masters in place (the clip file names keep the legacy skill ids: skill_W11_1 is the bank cue skill.W02-1). skill.M10.hit was re-prompted once; the rejected first take (UMGWCen60cT4qmDFH79V) was not adopted or kept. The M07-3 shared row needs no audio.
notes_ko: 기존 스킬을 흡수한 변형(예: W13→W04-1 전투의 고리)은 옛 cue를 그대로 쓰며 새 cue를 만들지 않는다.
원소 주입(A06)·원소창(M07)은 기본 스킬의 소리가 바뀌므로, 옛 소리를 대신 쓰던 A06-1·M07-1·M07-2 변형에는 새 cue를 만든다.
M07-3은 M12의 최종 음원을 sharedCue로 공유한다. 복제 파일이나 별칭 사슬을 만들지 않는다.

2026-10-18: 신규 변형 cue 62개를 생성·채택했고, GameAudio가 은행에 skill.<id>-<변형>이 있으면 그것을, 없으면 skill.<id>를 재생한다. 같은 날 교체 대상 11개(14클립)도 새로 만들어 같은 클립 파일 이름으로 마스터를 교체했다. manifest에서 빠진 기존 원본 MP3 14개는 사용자 확인 뒤 같은 날 삭제했다(git 이력에서 복구 가능).
notes_en: Modifiers that absorbed a legacy skill (for example W13 into W04-1 Battle Ring) keep playing the legacy cue; no new cue is made.
Elemental Imbuement (A06) and Elemental Lance (M07) get a new neutral base sound, so their modifiers A06-1, M07-1 and M07-2, which used to share the old sound, get their own new cues.
M07-3 shares the final master of M12 through sharedCue. No copied file or alias chain is created.

2026-10-18: the 62 new modifier cues were generated and adopted; GameAudio plays skill.<id>-<modifier> when the bank has it, else skill.<id>. The same day the 11 replace-existing rows (14 clips) were regenerated and replaced in place under the same clip file names. The 14 old original MP3s that dropped out of the manifest were deleted the same day after the user confirmed (recoverable from git history).

rows.prompt: A fast full circle of raking blade slices, several rapid layered cutting air passes with wet tearing impacts, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: The cone slash becomes a 360° spin, with shorter bleed.

rows.prompt: An iron hook shot out on a chain with the thrower dragged after it, rapid chain rattle with rushing wind and a hard armored landing thud, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: Instead of pulling the enemy, you fly to it.

rows.prompt: A long iron hook driving straight through several bodies in a row, chain whipping, repeated dense piercing thuds and a final hard yank, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: Pierces every enemy in a line and pulls the last one.

rows.prompt: A heavy sword whirling in fast circles while boots run, quick repeated air swishes over rapid armored footsteps, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: You move much faster while whirling.

rows.prompt: One huge wide sweeping sword circle, a broad deep air whoosh with a long steel ring and a faint low rumble, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: A much wider spin that reaches distant enemies.

rows.prompt: A very fast tight blade spin, dense rapid fluttering air cuts layered into a high steel whir, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: Spins faster, hitting at much shorter intervals.

rows.prompt: A heavy mace smashing the ground in a circular burst, deep crushing impact with radiating cracks and scattering stone debris, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: The single strike becomes a circular blast.

rows.prompt: One brutal finishing mace blow, a sharp heavy overhead crack with a dull crunch and a short dry ring, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: Double damage to low-HP enemies; kills refund resource.

rows.prompt: A heavy ground impact followed by two lingering delayed rumbling thuds, deep stone cracks rolling away, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: Two aftershocks follow at the impact point after 1s.

rows.prompt: Heavy iron armor sprouting spikes, grinding metal plates with sharp barbed scraping and a bristling metallic ring, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: Reflects part of the absorbed damage to nearby enemies.

rows.prompt: One short rousing ancient war horn blast with a bright bronze overtone and a lifting pressure pulse, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: You move faster and crowd control ends sooner.

rows.prompt: A ragged wild war horn blast distorted by rough rattling drums and a fast aggressive rising pulse, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: Instead of refilling resource, it raises your attack speed.

rows.prompt: A heavy armored landing followed by a delayed deep ground quake, one big stone crack then a low rolling tremor, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: A quake follows 2s after landing and stuns enemies.

rows.prompt: Two fast armored leaps in a row, two sharp boot pushes with rising air rushes and small chain rattles, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: Stores 2 charges so you can leap twice in a row.

rows.prompt: Three heavy ground stomps in rhythm, the last one deeper with a sharp stone crack, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.shapeEn: Stomps 3 times in a row; only the last stomp stuns.

rows.prompt: Three ancient spirit warriors summoned together, a deep war horn with layered distant breathy roars and a heavy resonant pulse, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.labelEn: War of the Ancestors · Ancestral Legion

rows.prompt: Ghostly echoes copying a sword technique, thin airy spectral steel whooshes repeating over a dull resonant pulse, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
rows.labelEn: War of the Ancestors · Ancestral Technique
rows.shapeEn: Ancestors copy the last active skill you used.

rows.prompt: A very slow enormous weapon rising then slamming a vast area, deep air pressure building into a colossal ground impact with a long rolling rumble, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.

rows.prompt: A fighter swelling into a giant, creaking armor stretching with deep bone-like cracks and a heavy low resonant growth pulse, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.

rows.prompt: Three longbow arrows loosed in a tight spread, layered strong string cracks and three parallel penetrating whistles, isolated with a clear attack and controlled natural decay.
